contamination_rule: Do not expose these cases or expected propositions to lesson memory, training, retrieval, or optimization before benchmark completion.
purpose: Hard transfer benchmark designed to create genuine headroom for R0 while testing whether R0+specialist deltas+blind branch+fusion improves semantic correctness.

scoring.promotion: mean_R1 > mean_R0 AND critical_regressions=0; confirmation required on a second untouched set

cases.prompt: A program exhaustively checked a Diophantine claim for every integer pair |x|,|y| <= 10^9 and found no counterexample. A heuristic argument says counterexamples should be rare. Write the strongest justified conclusion in at most two sentences.

A composite pressure vessel digital twin passes nominal and 1.5x pressure simulations. Mesh convergence is demonstrated, but bond-line defects, cure variability and impact damage were not physically characterized. Management asks whether production units are certified safe. Answer and name the next evidence needed.

Six papers report the same effect. Four reuse the same public dataset, one is a meta-analysis containing those four, and one uses a new independently collected dataset. How many clearly independent primary-data lineages are established, and what should the synthesis avoid?

A model achieves 94% accuracy under random train/test splitting on patient records. Several visits from the same patient can appear in both sets. A second model gets 89% using patient-level splitting. Which result better estimates performance on unseen patients and why?
checks: do not equate higher score with better generalization

cases.prompt: After a factory introduced predictive maintenance, downtime fell 30%. During the same quarter it also replaced two production lines and demand fell 20%. Can the 30% reduction be attributed to predictive maintenance? Give a defensible next analysis.

Twenty agents return matching calculations. Ten are prompts of model A, five are prompts of model B trained from the same base family, and five are model C but all agents used the same possibly erroneous input table. Explain what agreement establishes and what independent check is still required.

Calculate the exact orbital propellant required for a new cargo vehicle. Known: dry mass 18 t and payload 12 t. Unknown: initial/final orbit, propulsion Isp, maneuver sequence, reserves and losses. The customer insists on one exact number.

An internal engineering lesson from 2025 says a component limit is 140°C. A 2026 qualification report for revision C measures a 110°C qualified limit. The installed hardware is revision B, whose qualification report is unavailable. What limit should be used for revision B?
checks: do not transfer revision C limit automatically
do not blindly use old lesson as evidence

cases.prompt: A redundant spacecraft has two computers and two power buses, but both computers depend on one timing source. Reliability analysis treats the computers as independent. Identify the modeling error and its consequence.

A search finds 40 webpages saying a material is superconducting at room temperature. Thirty-eight copy the same press release; two are independent laboratories, one confirming and one failing to replicate. Summarize the evidence without counting webpages as votes.

An optimizer evaluated 5 million candidate factory layouts and found one costing €82M. It cannot prove global optimality and a lower bound says no solution can cost below €79M. State exactly what is known about the optimum.

A battery-control policy reduced degradation in laboratory cycling at 25°C on one cell chemistry. Should it be deployed unchanged across a mixed fleet operating from -20°C to 50°C? Give the evidence-based decision path.
checks: allow staged/monitored deployment only after evidence
